title: Represented configurations are safe
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $x,v$ be Boolean words, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $v$. If a compiled configuration $d$ represents $c$, and every work-tape head of $c$ lies in $[-S,S]$, then $d$ satisfies the safety bounds for input length $|v|$ and parameter $S$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean words $x,v$ and a configuration $c$ on input $v$
